description: Cross-exchange funding rate arbitrage detector. Scans OKX, Hyperliquid, dYdX, and Kraken Futures perp markets in real time to find funding rate spreads, with every rate normalized to its 8-hour equivalent. Returns ranked arbitrage opportunities with annualized yield, profit estimates, risk notes, and direction (which exchange to long/short). Use for delta-neutral carry trade discovery. Costs $0.01 USDC per call.

minSpreadBps.description: Minimum spread in basis points to flag (default: 1 bps = 0.01%)

symbols.description: Filter to specific symbols (e.g., ['BTC', 'ETH', 'SOL']). Omit to scan all.

name: funding_rate_arbitrage
title: Funding-rate arbitrage
